title: P600,000 in marijuana plants destroyed at Ilocos Sur town border

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police uprooted and destroyed 3,000 fully grown marijuana plants worth an estimated P600,000 in Sugpon town in this province on Sunday. The plantation spans about 1,000 square meters in Sitio Ogiyet, Barangay Licungan, near the boundary with Barangay Tacadang at Benguet’s Kibungan town. Police uprooted the plants, documented and inventoried them, then destroyed them by burning the illegal plants at the site. READ: 5,200 marijuana plants destroyed in Ilocos Sur The latest operation was part of continuing marijuana eradication programs in the mountainous areas of Sugpon, where authorities have repeatedly discovered cultivation sites this year.
